No, that isn't what the tool found. The result is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because of missing coverage. The source data this asset needs (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) hasn't been prepared, so no observation was made and the observations list is empty.

The tool therefore establishes neither that loss occurred nor that no loss occurred. It also makes no compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant or deforestation-free.

The claim covered tree-cover loss across the whole asset boundary from 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, against a 2020-12-31 baseline. None of that period was assessed.

To get an answer, the missing source coverage would need to be prepared and the analysis rerun. Until then, treat the asset's loss status as unknown.
